"""Continue OWN25us/12.5us body histories from360.6ms to500ms.

Zero-gravity diagnostic, no prefix replay, no full prior-history claim.
Retain every new common raw endpoint and cumulative work/impulse once.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import sys

BASE=Path('/tmp/a1-body-paired-load-release-20260927.py')
BASE_SHA='00ec0ce0a2e94b6254bb7801a4fcf41eea5918c16503b334353a65cd553f344b'
b=BASE.read_bytes()
if hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()!=BASE_SHA:raise RuntimeError('reviewed envelope changed')
exec(compile(b.decode().split("\nif __name__=='__main__':",1)[0],'<reviewed no-build envelope>','exec'),globals())
HERE=Path(__file__).resolve()
RADAU=Path('/tmp/guala-body-history.ymsk1edz/python/guala_body_radau.cpython-311-x86_64-linux-gnu.so')
RADAU_SHA='29162c2275b9ce72816c7ac8377367b4d06b6857ae0bf9d6b7a49c0959f1c8f7'
SOURCE_SHA='4baebe4f8e3a522736196e5ed035451c13714b045fcb97b156b87eebba8e2bf1'
PARENTS={
 'FB-01aj-paired-refined-continuation.json':'0f1e812f60245c087c3d153659d8fe44c39397981291873afde3bf94e86770b6',
 'FB-01aj-finer-independent-history-12us-a632e187d68d.json':'960a5e11c027a8f820802f200c0b035a1f115df4dd6698f4307ac5cd2339e274',
}
SCHEMA_OUT='guala.functional-body.quarter-eighth-continuation.v1'
TARGET_NAME='FB-01aj-quarter-eighth-continuation.json'
RESUME=None


def diagnostic():
    global CPU_LIMIT,MAX_TRIALS
    source=ACCEPTED.read_bytes()
    require(hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest()==ACCEPTED_SHA,'observer changed')
    exec(compile(source.decode().split('\nresult=dict(schema=SCHEMA,completed=False',1)[0],
                 '<accepted numerical observer>','exec'),globals())
    CPU_LIMIT,MAX_TRIALS=50.,30000
    result=dict(schema=SCHEMA_OUT,completed=False,failure=None,first_failure=None,
        mounted=False,full_body_qualification=False,continuum_enclosure=False,
        scope='actual25us/12.5us360.6ms predecessors through500ms; zero gravity; no prefix replay',
        prior_coverage='12.5us compared only at archived endpoints before360.6ms; missing between-endpoint reference comparison remains OPEN',
        parent_receipt=None if RESUME is None else dict(file=RESUME[0],sha256=RESUME[1]),
        samples=[],endpoints=[],comparisons=[],lanes=[],resumed_inputs=[],
        last_common_time_s=None,prior_sample_count=0,prior_cpu_seconds=0.,
        active_restore=None,active_successors=None,failed_attempt=None,local_event_refinements=[],suffix_paths=[])
    cases=[];lanes=[];errors=Errors()
    mj.mj_forward=forward

    def load(name,sha):
        b=Path('docs/evidence',name).read_bytes()
        require(hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==sha,'parent file differs')
        r=json.loads(b)
        require(r['measurement_recorded'] and r['health_error'] is None and r.get('operational_error') is None
                and r['execution']['exit_code']==0 and not r['execution']['survivors'],'parent execution differs')
        p=r['raw_measurement'];b=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(p['payload_zlib_base64'],validate=True))
        require(len(b)==p['raw_bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==p['raw_sha256'],'parent payload differs')
        return json.loads(b)

    def vector(value):
        if isinstance(value,dict):
            require(set(value)=={'shape','finite','float64_le_base64'} and value['shape']==[3]
                    and value['finite'] is True,'packed impulse descriptor differs')
            b=base64.b64decode(value['float64_le_base64'],validate=True)
            require(len(b)==24,'packed impulse byte count differs')
            v=np.frombuffer(b,dtype='<f8').copy()
        else:
            require(isinstance(value,list),'plain impulse descriptor differs')
            v=np.asarray(value,dtype='<f8')
        require(v.shape==(3,) and bool(np.all(np.isfinite(v))),'nonfinite/invalid impulse')
        return v

    def impulses(rows):
        return {tuple(r['pair']):(vector(r['force']),vector(r['couple']),r['force_path'],r['couple_path']) for r in rows}

    def capture(c):
        state=np.empty_like(c.e._state_buffer)
        mj.mj_getState(c.m,c.d,state,interval.STATE_KIND)
        return dict(time_s=float(c.d.time),state=radau.packed_numbers(state))

    def restore(c,saved):
        row=dict(expected_state_base64=saved['state_base64'],expected_time_s=saved['time_s'],
                 expected_observation=saved.get('observation'),completed=False)
        result['active_restore']=row;result['resumed_inputs'].append(row)
        try:
            b=base64.b64decode(saved['state_base64'],validate=True)
            interval._restore(c.e,np.frombuffer(b,dtype='<f8').copy(),H)
            require(primary(c.e)==b and float(c.d.time)==saved['time_s'],'restored state/time differs')
            row['actual_observation']=asdict(c.e._observation())
            if saved.get('observation') is not None:
                require(json.dumps(row['actual_observation'],sort_keys=True)==json.dumps(saved['observation'],sort_keys=True),
                        'restored force/sensory observation differs')
            require(not np.any(c.d.ctrl),'retained torque release absent')
            snap=interval._snapshot(c.e)
            row['completed']=True
            return dict(snapshot=snap,work=tuple(saved['work']),impulses=impulses(saved['impulses']),
                        sequence=(plain_domain(snap['domain']),),brackets=[])
        finally:
            try:row['actual']=capture(c)
            except Exception as error:row['extraction_error']=repr(error)

    def operand(lane):
        return dict(time_s=lane['snapshot']['time'],state_base64=raw(lane['snapshot']['state'].tobytes()),
            work=lane['work'],impulses=radau._record_impulses(lane['impulses']),
            sequence=lane['sequence'],brackets=lane['brackets'])

    def observed_restore(c,l,row,body_snapshot):
        expected=l['snapshot']['state'].tobytes()
        row.update(expected_state_sha256=hashlib.sha256(expected).hexdigest(),
                   expected_time_s=l['snapshot']['time'],completed=False)
        try:
            interval._restore(c.e,l['snapshot']['state'],H)
            c.work=l['work'];c.impulses=l['impulses']
            observation=c.snapshot() if body_snapshot else asdict(c.e._observation())
            require(primary(c.e)==expected and float(c.d.time)==l['snapshot']['time'],
                    'observed restore state/time differs')
            row['completed']=True
            return observation
        except Exception as error:
            row['restore_observation_error']=repr(error)
            raise
        finally:
            try:
                actual=capture(c)
                if row['completed']:
                    state=base64.b64decode(actual['state']['float64_le_base64'],validate=True)
                    row.update(actual_state_sha256=hashlib.sha256(state).hexdigest(),
                               actual_time_s=actual['time_s'],state_exact=state==expected)
                else:row['actual']=actual
            except Exception as error:
                row['extraction_error']=repr(error)
                if row['completed']:
                    row['completed']=False
                    raise

    def compare(pair,kind):
        now=pair[0]['snapshot']['time']
        verdict=radau.trajectory_agreement(cases[1].e,*pair,now)
        row=dict(time_s=now,kind=kind,verdict=verdict,restores=[])
        result['comparisons'].append(row)
        observed=[]
        for label,c,l in zip(('quarter','eighth'),cases,pair):
            evidence=dict(label=label);row['restores'].append(evidence)
            observed.append(observed_restore(c,l,evidence,True))
        errors.compare(*cases,*observed,now*1e6)
        require(verdict['passed'] and errors.first_failure is None and not errors.unresolved_touch['samples'],
                'paired continuation physical/sensory/event discrepancy')
        result['last_common_time_s']=now

    try:
        control=archived_controls()[100]
        cases=[Trajectory(100,control),Trajectory(100,control)]
        result['genesis_base64']=raw(primary(cases[0].e));result['initial_supply_j']=control['initial_supply_j']
        if RESUME is None:
            old,new=[load(n,s) for n,s in PARENTS.items()]
            require(new['completed'] and new['failure'] is None and new['first_failure'] is None
                    and all(r['completed'] for r in new['comparisons']),'new finer endpoint not supported')
            fine=new['lane'];bad=old['failed_attempt']['pair_report']['disagreement']
            require(not bad['state_work_impulse_passed'] and bad['same_event_sequence'] and bad['paired_event_brackets_within_limit'],
                    'wrong prior refusal')
            proof=new['comparisons'][-1]
            require(fine['genesis_base64']==result['genesis_base64'] and fine['nominal_dt_s']==H/8
                    and fine['time_s']==bad['time_s']==proof['time_s'],'incompatible own history')
            require(proof['reference']['state_base64']==bad['fine_state']['float64_le_base64']
                    and proof['reference']['work']==bad['fine_work'] and proof['reference']['impulses']==bad['fine_impulses'],
                    '25us reference provenance differs')
            require(proof['actual']['state_base64']==fine['state_base64'] and proof['work']==fine['work'],
                    '12.5us returned provenance differs')
            proof_impulses,lane_impulses=impulses(proof['impulses']),impulses(fine['impulses'])
            require(proof_impulses.keys()==lane_impulses.keys() and all(
                proof_impulses[k][0].tobytes()==lane_impulses[k][0].tobytes() and
                proof_impulses[k][1].tobytes()==lane_impulses[k][1].tobytes() and
                np.asarray(proof_impulses[k][2:],dtype='<f8').tobytes()==
                np.asarray(lane_impulses[k][2:],dtype='<f8').tobytes()
                for k in proof_impulses),'12.5us cumulative impulse provenance differs')
            saved=[dict(proof['reference'],observation=proof['reference_restore']['actual_observation']),fine]
            lanes=[restore(c,s) for c,s in zip(cases,saved)]
            result['inherited_remaining_supply_j']=[s['remaining_supply_j'] for s in saved]
            result['suffix_start_s']=bad['time_s']
            result['suffix_paths']=[dict(sequence=list(l['sequence']),brackets=[]) for l in lanes]
        else:
            parent=load(*RESUME)
            require(parent['schema']==SCHEMA_OUT and not parent['completed'] and parent['first_failure'] is None,
                    'not a bounded unfinished pair')
            require(parent['failure']['type']=='RuntimeError' and parent['failure']['error']==
                    'bounded admitted-motion diagnostic exhausted; qualification incomplete','not a CPU/trial-only stop')
            require(all(r['verdict']['passed'] for r in parent['comparisons']),'prior pair comparison failed')
            failed=parent['failed_attempt']
            require(failed is None or failed['pair_report']['rollback_exact'] is True,'prior pair rollback absent')
            require(parent['genesis_base64']==result['genesis_base64'] and parent['initial_supply_j']==result['initial_supply_j'],
                    'resume anatomy/energy source differs')
            saved=parent['lanes']
            require(len(saved)==2 and [s['label'] for s in saved]==['quarter','eighth']
                    and all(s['time_s']==parent['last_common_time_s'] for s in saved),'resume lane custody differs')
            lanes=[restore(c,s) for c,s in zip(cases,saved)]
            result['suffix_start_s']=parent['suffix_start_s'];result['suffix_paths']=parent['suffix_paths']
            result['prior_sample_count']=parent['prior_sample_count']+len(parent['samples'])
            result['prior_cpu_seconds']=parent['prior_cpu_seconds']+parent['cpu_seconds']
            metrics=parent['metrics']
            errors.groups={k:v['channels'] for k,v in metrics.items() if 'channels' in v}
            touch=metrics['local_tactile_correspondence'];errors.unresolved_touch={k:touch[k] for k in ('samples','first','last')}
            errors.matched_touch_points=touch['matched_points'];errors.empty_touch_samples=touch['both_empty_samples']
            errors.couple_impulse=metrics['intrinsic_couple_impulse']['pairs']
        result['active_successors']=[operand(l) for l in lanes]
        compare(lanes,'retained_own_predecessors');result['active_successors']=None
        for path,lane in zip(result['suffix_paths'],lanes):
            require(len(path['sequence'])==len(path['brackets'])+1 and
                plain_domain(path['sequence'][-1])==plain_domain(lane['snapshot']['domain']),'retained suffix path differs')
        while lanes[0]['snapshot']['time']<.5:
            budget();stop=next_sample(lanes[0]['snapshot']['time'],.5)
            probe.steps.clear();probe.trace.clear();probe.last_pair_admission=None
            count=attempts
            try:
                successors,receipt=probe.admit_history_pair(cases[1].e,lanes,stop,0.,control['initial_supply_j'],
                    (H/4,H/8),MAX_TRIALS-attempts)
                result['active_successors']=[]
                for l in successors:result['active_successors'].append(operand(l))
                require(receipt['trials']==attempts-count,'primitive accounting differs')
                require(all(a['work'][0]==b['work'][0] for a,b in zip(lanes,successors)),
                        'released continuation spent motor work')
                if len(receipt['rounds'])>1:result['local_event_refinements'].append(receipt)
                compare(successors,'new_interval')
                for path,lane in zip(result['suffix_paths'],successors):
                    require(plain_domain(path['sequence'][-1])==plain_domain(lane['sequence'][0]),'new suffix path discontinuity')
                for path,lane in zip(result['suffix_paths'],successors):
                    path['sequence'].extend(lane['sequence'][1:]);path['brackets'].extend(lane['brackets'])
                result['endpoints'].append(result['active_successors']);result['active_successors']=None
            except Exception as error:
                result['failed_attempt']=dict(error=repr(error),pair_report=probe.last_pair_admission)
                try:result['failed_attempt']['scratch']=capture(cases[1])
                except Exception as extraction:result['failed_attempt']['extraction_error']=repr(extraction)
                raise
            lanes=successors;result['samples'].append(stop)
            if len(result['samples'])%100==0:
                print('PROGRESS',json.dumps(dict(time_s=stop,attempts=attempts,cpu_seconds=time.process_time()-started_cpu)),flush=True)
        budget();result['completed']=True
    except Exception as error:
        result['failure']=dict(type=type(error).__name__,error=str(error),traceback=traceback.format_exc(limit=8))
    finally:
        mj.mj_forward=native_forward
        for label,c,l in zip(('quarter','eighth'),cases,lanes):
            row=dict(label=label);result['lanes'].append(row)
            try:
                row.update(operand(l))
                row['remaining_supply_j']=control['initial_supply_j']-l['work'][0]
                row['observation']=observed_restore(c,l,row,False)
            except Exception as error:
                row['observation_error']=repr(error);result['completed']=False
                if result['failure'] is None:
                    result['failure']=dict(type=type(error).__name__,error=str(error),phase='terminal_evidence')
        result.update(metrics=errors.result(),first_failure=errors.first_failure,attempts=attempts,calls=probe.calls,
            call_accounting=audit,native_seconds=probe.native_seconds,observed_primitive_seconds=probe.transition_seconds,
            observer_seconds=probe.observer_seconds,cpu_seconds=time.process_time()-started_cpu,
            wall_seconds=time.perf_counter()-started_wall)
    print(json.dumps(encode(result)),flush=True)


if __name__=='__main__':
    if '--resume' in sys.argv:
        at=sys.argv.index('--resume');require(at==len(sys.argv)-3,'resume arguments must be terminal')
        name,sha=sys.argv[at+1:]
        require(Path(name).name==name and name.startswith('FB-01aj-quarter-eighth-continuation') and name.endswith('.json')
                and len(sha)==64 and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in sha),'invalid resume custody')
        RESUME=(name,sha);TARGET_NAME='FB-01aj-quarter-eighth-continuation-'+sha[:12]+'.json';del sys.argv[at:]
    if sys.argv[1:]==['--child']:diagnostic()
    else:run()
